bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; clarifying application of increased funding for water infrastructure grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPLICABILITY OF INCREASED FUNDING FOR WATER INFRASTRUCTURE GRANTS. +]

[+The maximum grant amount for water infrastructure grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 446A.072, subdivision 5a, as set in Laws 2025, First Special Session chapter 15, article 2, section 5, is available to all projects subject to a grant agreement under Minnesota Statutes, section 446A.072, subdivision 5a, as of September 1, 2024, or thereafter. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; clarifying application of increased funding for water infrastructure grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPLICABILITY OF INCREASED FUNDING FOR WATER INFRASTRUCTURE GRANTS.

The maximum grant amount for water infrastructure grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 446A.072, subdivision 5a, as set in Laws 2025, First Special Session chapter 15, article 2, section 5, is available to all projects subject to a grant agreement under Minnesota Statutes, section 446A.072, subdivision 5a, as of September 1, 2024, or thereafter.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: APPLICABILITY OF INCREASED FUNDING FOR WATER INFRASTRUCTURE GRANTS.

The maximum grant amount for water infrastructure grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 446A.072, subdivision 5a, as set in Laws 2025, First Special Session chapter 15, article 2, section 5, is available to all projects subject to a grant agreement under Minnesota Statutes, section 446A.072, subdivision 5a, as of September 1, 2024, or thereafter.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
